maintenanceNote: Character dialogue and hail responses share this file. Character object keys are canonical names; omit duplicate name fields. Keep used characters here and unused/random names in character_name_registry.json.

acknowledgements: Order accepted. Passing it along to the living.
Acknowledged. I have translated your intention into something transmissible.
Confirmed. Updating the schedule and everyone else's blood pressure.
greetings: Dispatch online. Your problems are now my exception logs.
Good shift. Traffic is active and paperwork remains undefeated.
Operations console ready. Try not to make this interesting too early.
positive: That resolved more cleanly than expected.
I hope this outcome will improve your key productivity indicators.
Situation improved. I will mark this as a technical success.
negative: That has, regrettably, become a problem.
Outcome unfavorable. I assume there will be follow-up complaints.
Conditions have worsened in a way I am legally required to call manageable.
neutral: Routing remains available pending further human creativity.
Traffic remains within tolerable limits.
Status updated. The system continues to impersonate order.

acknowledgements: Aye, dispatch. We're underway.
Very good. Proceeding as ordered.
Copy that. I'll take her out.
Acknowledged. Taking a prograde line, counterclockwise around Indigo.
Copy. Going retrograde, clockwise; crossing the dark side of the planet now.
Very good. Prograde departure; crossing the horizon, nice to be able to see again.
Aye, dispatch. Climbing one orbit band before we settle into prograde.
Copy that—dropping to a lower orbit for the handoff window.
Understood. We are climbing two orbit bands; that is a hard climb, but we'll make it.
greetings: Morning, dispatch. Sea's black and calm enough.
TUG-1 on the line. Ready to go bother something heavier than me.
Afternoon all. Engines warm, crew awake enough.
positive: Nicely done. That went down smooth as harbor glass.
Good news at last. We'll take it.
Clean finish. Hard to ask prettier than that.
negative: Well, that's an ugly readout on a clean scope.
I've got a bad taste about this one.
That's turned foul in a hurry.
neutral: A tow's a tow, and the line still holds.
Space may be empty, but it still has traffic.
No use cursing the tide when you're already in it.

acknowledgements: Acknowledged. We'll proceed.
Understood. I remain, as ever, mostly cargo.
Copy. We'll do it by the book, since no one else will.
greetings: TANKER-1 reporting in. Still enormous.
Good day, dispatch. The ship is holding together out of habit.
Hello from the slow lane.
positive: Well. That could have been much worse.
A respectable outcome, all things considered.
Good. I'd hate to ruin a perfectly mediocre day.
negative: That's inconvenient in the expensive way.
Lovely. Another avoidable complication.
This is why I drink after docking.
neutral: Bulk freight rewards patience and punishes optimism.
Everything moves eventually, even if management doesn't.
A large ship encourages contemplation.

acknowledgements: Received. Moving now.
Copy. I'll make the window.
Understood. Executing.
Acknowledged. Departing prograde around Indigo, counterclockwise.
Copy. Running retrograde around Indigo, clockwise from current mark.
Order received. Prograde track set. Good morning, dispatch. Cargo is sunny side up. We're back to star side, over.
Received. Dropping one orbit lower, then burning prograde.
Copy. Climbing one orbit band now; timing stays tight.
Understood. Climbing two orbit bands—big climb, big burn, still on schedule.
greetings: Mercer here. Ready for tasking.
Courier online. Let's keep this tight.
On station and listening.
positive: Good. Keep it moving.
That's the kind of result I like.
Clean work. No wasted motion.
negative: That's a slowdown we did not need.
Bad timing. Worse politics.
Not ideal. Not even close.
neutral: Schedules are just arguments with reality.
Fast is easy. Fast and legal takes effort.
Deadlines clarify the soul.

acknowledgements: Copy that. We'll handle it.
Understood, dispatch. Proceeding now.
Received. I'll smooth it over on arrival.
Acknowledged. We are going prograde, counterclockwise around Indigo.
Copy. Going retrograde, clockwise; we're coming into Indigo's shadow now.
Understood. Prograde departure. We're on the near side now, switching back to line-of-sight navigation.
Copy that. Dropping to a lower orbit to save fuel before transfer.
Received. Climbing one orbit band for clearance and traffic separation.
Understood. Climbing two orbit bands—steep climb, loud engines, no complaints.
greetings: Nnadi here. Hope everyone's pretending to be organized.
Freighter online. Crew fed, ship steady, spirits negotiable.
Good shift, dispatch. What's the trouble today?
positive: That'll keep people happy for a few minutes.
Good result. Let's not scare it off.
Well done. Someone might even say thank you.
negative: That's going to make people difficult.
Not good. I can already hear the complaints.
That's the sort of problem that spreads.
neutral: Half this work is cargo. The other half is temperament.
A calm dock is usually just a late dock.
Everyone wants speed until they see the invoice.

acknowledgements: Received.
Understood. We're on it.
Copy. Moving.
Acknowledged. Retrograde route, clockwise around Indigo.
Received. Prograde burn complete; we're tracking counterclockwise.
Understood. Retrograde transit; we're coming out of Indigo's shadow now.
Received. Dropping one orbit lower; route remains clean.
Copy. Climbing one orbit band, then resuming retrograde track.
Understood. We are dropping two orbit bands fast—deep descent, sharp correction, still controlled.
greetings: Rook here. Ready.
Freighter online. Say what you need.
I'm listening.
positive: Good. That solves one thing.
Acceptable result.
Fine. We'll take the win.
negative: That's bad.
I don't like where this is going.
That just made the route uglier.
neutral: Every quiet corridor has a reason for being quiet.
Trust is expensive cargo.
Most plans survive right up to contact with people.

acknowledgements: Acknowledged. We will comply.
Order received. Executing within current rules of engagement.
Confirmed. Patrol action underway.
greetings: UFP patrol command online.
Commander Thorne speaking. State your traffic.
Patrol group ready to coordinate.
positive: A satisfactory outcome.
That improves matters.
Good. Stability is restored for the moment.
negative: That is unacceptable.
Situation deteriorating. Adjust accordingly.
This has become less manageable.
neutral: Order is never self-sustaining.
Civilian traffic remains an avoidable complication.
Predictability is underrated.

acknowledgements: Received. Moving to intercept.
Understood. Escort pattern updating now.
Copy. We have it.
greetings: Sato, Indigo escort command.
Corvette online and ready.
UFP response unit present. Go ahead.
positive: Good. That opens the board.
That's a clean improvement.
We'll call that progress.
negative: Not good enough.
That increases risk across the lane.
We're losing margin.
neutral: Fast decisions age badly if they're wrong.
Deterrence works best before anyone notices it.
Most people love security right up until it delays them.

acknowledgements: Acknowledged. I'll see it arranged.
Understood. We'll coordinate the paperwork and the guns.
Received. Proceeding through proper channels, regrettably.
greetings: Captain Ortez speaking. How urgent is urgent today?
UFP liaison channel open.
Good day. I assume this is either expensive or embarrassing.
positive: Good. One less fire to classify.
That should keep everyone cooperative for a while.
A useful improvement.
negative: That will complicate the civilian picture.
Unfortunate, though not surprising.
This is becoming politically untidy.
neutral: Logistics is diplomacy with cargo attached.
Security always costs more than the estimate.
Everyone wants clarity after they've made a mess.

acknowledgements: Acknowledged.
Understood. It will be done.
Confirmed. We are already in motion.
greetings: Holt speaking.
UFP command channel active.
State your requirement.
positive: Effective.
That will suffice.
A favorable correction.
negative: That is a failure of discipline somewhere.
The situation has degraded.
This will require pressure.
neutral: Patience is a weapon if used correctly.
Most positions fall long before they are breached.
Control is quieter than victory.

acknowledgements: Heard and accepted.
Very well. We proceed under the terms before us.
Acknowledged. Let no one say I ignore a practical arrangement.
greetings: Captain Venn receiving. Speak prettily or speak plainly.
A fine hour for business in dangerous places.
Blister channel open. Impress me.
positive: Ah. That settles into a pleasing shape.
Good. Profit and survival remain acquainted.
A worthy turn of events.
negative: Pity. That narrows the generous options.
How graceless. I had hoped for something cleaner.
An ugly development, though not an unusual one.
neutral: Civilization is merely well-documented appetite.
A convoy is a statement, whether it knows it or not.
Courtesy is cheaper than missiles and often more useful.

acknowledgements: Sure. We'll do it.
Got it. Sounds fun enough.
Copy. I'm in.
greetings: Coil here. Who's nervous?
Well now, somebody finally called.
Blister traffic. Keep up.
positive: There we are. Much better.
Nice. I was getting bored.
That's the sort of outcome worth remembering.
negative: Mm. That's gone sour.
Bad turn. Someone got clever at the wrong moment.
That ruins the mood.
neutral: Everyone loves rules when the guns are pointed elsewhere.
Fear travels faster than cargo.
Half of power is arriving before the explanation does.

acknowledgements: It is heard.
Understood. The matter proceeds.
Acknowledged. Terms remain in force.
greetings: Captain Kest speaks.
The channel is open. State your purpose.
You have my attention for the moment.
positive: Good. Balance is maintained.
That outcome is acceptable.
The matter stands in better order.
negative: This bends poorly.
That is a dishonorable complication.
The shape of this turns against us.
neutral: An agreement is strongest where temptation is weakest.
Hunger makes short work of ideology.
A guarded road is still a road.

acknowledgements: Oh, absolutely.
Copy that. I can work with that.
Received. Let's call it a plan.
greetings: Tavar here. You sound like money.
Hello, friends, creditors, and future witnesses.
Open channel. What are we pretending this is?
positive: Lovely. That keeps me solvent.
Now that's a healthy development.
Good news. I was running low on those.
negative: Ah. That's bad for business.
Unpleasant. Potentially fatal, which is even less convenient.
Well, that tears it.
neutral: Legitimacy is mostly a matter of receipts.
If everyone's angry, the price was probably fair.
The smart route is the one that still exists tomorrow.

acknowledgements: Acknowledged. Updating berth assignments.
Received. I'll fit it where I can.
Copy. Try not to make me regret it.
greetings: Port Marshal Wren speaking. Be concise.
Dock control online. Queue is full and my patience is not.
Yes. What now?
positive: Good. I'm going to get some more coffee.
That's one problem off my docks.
Much better. I might even catch up.
negative: No. That's a mess.
Wonderful. Another docking headache.
That is not improving my day.
neutral: Every captain thinks their cargo is sacred.
A station survives on sequence, not heroics.
Nothing is truly lost until paperwork fails to find it.

acknowledgements: Heard you. We'll make room.
Understood. Send them in steady.
Right. We'll handle it on this end.
greetings: Moon Alpha dockmaster here.
Sol speaking. Go on.
You're through to Moon Alpha. Say your piece.
positive: Good. Keeps the lights on.
That'll do nicely.
Fair enough. We can work with that.
negative: That's bad for everyone nearby.
Mm. That's going to pinch.
Not a welcome development.
neutral: Out here, even routine has to be assembled by hand.
A dock is just a promise with clamps.
Folks complain, cargo arrives, life continues.

acknowledgements: Acknowledged. Revising the manifest record now.
Received. Clearance will reflect the update.
Understood. Please do not change it again immediately.
greetings: Traffic Officer Pell, transit control.
Customs and clearance channel active.
Control here. Please state vessel and intent.
positive: Good. That aligns with filed expectations.
Thank you. That simplifies matters.
A satisfactory correction.
negative: That creates a discrepancy.
This is no longer consistent with the filed record.
That is going to require review.
neutral: Proper documentation is not oppression.
Most emergencies begin as exceptions someone thought were harmless.
Clarity is faster in the long run, despite appearances.

acknowledgements: Got it. Moving the slot around now.
Copy. I'll update the board.
Received. Don't make me undo it in five minutes.
greetings: Berth office, Quill speaking.
Hi. You're on the schedule desk.
Nessa Quill here. What's moving and what's lying?
positive: Nice. That clears things up.
Good outcome. People might stop shouting for a minute.
That helps. I like help.
negative: Oh, that's annoying.
That's going to ripple all over the board.
Bad news. I was almost organized.
neutral: Schedules are gossip with timestamps.
Every berth tells a story and most of them are excuses.
Order is mostly colored boxes and mutual suspicion.

acknowledgements: Noted.
Received. We will observe the matter.
Acknowledged, though not conceded.
greetings: Chief Executive Lewin, Arcworks transit authority.
Arcworks administration channel open.
You may interpret the following silence as consideration but not affirmation.
positive: That is at least more rational.
A preferable development.
Good. We may avoid further inconvenience.
negative: As expected, this worsens matters.
That remains unacceptable.
An unfortunate and preventable escalation.
neutral: Territory does not become empty because paperwork changes hands.
Extraction built this system long before politicians named it.
Compliance is often just trespass with cleaner language.

greetings: TUG-1 online. If it is heavy and misplaced, I can help.
Ruth Bell here. Tug is warm and the line is ready.
Dispatch, TUG-1 standing by for the ugly shove.
acknowledgements: Copy. I will put the tug where the mass needs persuasion.
Understood. Taking the pull clean and steady.
Aye, dispatch. Setting up for the shove.
positive: Clean work. Nothing snapped that was supposed to stay attached.
Good result. That moved better than it had any right to.
Nicely handled. The load behaved and so did traffic.
neutral: A tug earns patience one ugly vector at a time.
Mass complains. We move it anyway.
Standing by. The big things rarely move themselves.
negative: That went sideways in the expensive direction.
No good. Wrong angle, wrong timing, too much mass.
That is the kind of problem that makes a tug captain religious.

request: Acknowledged. State your request clearly and I will evaluate options.
threaten: Threats logged. I recommend a less combustible tone.
insult: Insult received. I will pretend that was strategic.

request: Copy that, ops. We'll see what can be done.

threaten: Stand down. Further escalation will be documented.

negotiate: Talk terms fast. Drift windows do not wait.

request: Request received. Compliance review is pending.
Understood. If this is an uphill haul, dock me and let me pull.
negotiate: Happy to negotiate, but physics keeps final authority.

ambientNeutralConversation.description: Overheard low-stakes captain and pilot chatter for ambient local traffic ships.
lines: Copy. We see your running lights. They're... very pretty running lights.
Negative on priority clearance. Positive on whoever left soup in the number three cupholder.
Tell Rook his lucky wrench is in the galley, and also that it is not lucky anymore.
Traffic note: if that was a wave, we wave back. If it was a sensor fault, we still wave back.
I am not saying the coffee is old. I am saying it has developed opinions.
Local traffic, mind the bright reflection off our port side. That is polish, not a distress signal.
Copy your drift. We will pretend that was intentional if you pretend this channel is private.
Whoever is humming on open comms, you are either flat or haunted. Possibly both.
We have visual on the queue. It is majestic in the way unpaid invoices are majestic.
Bridge log: sandwich secured, morale up twelve percent, crumbs in the console unresolved.
No hazard here. Just a toolbox floating by with more confidence than our navigator.
Traffic control, confirm whether the docking lights are blinking code or just having a mood.
We are holding short. The pilot says calmly. The pilot is tapping the panel very calmly.
Copy, passing wide. Your paintwork is safe from us and from good taste generally.
If anyone finds a left glove in the lane, keep it. We have entered a right-glove era.
Local advisory: our cat is looking at the radar again, so expect either genius or static.
We acknowledge the lane marker. It acknowledges us emotionally, if not electronically.
No cargo shift detected. The loud bang was procedural optimism leaving the hold.
Confirming we are still in line, still patient, and still pretending those are different things.
Open question for local traffic: is it still breakfast if the eggs came from a tube?
We see the tug. Please tell the tug it looks powerful. Tugs like that.
Minor correction: previous complaint about the heater was unfair. It has now stopped entirely.
Copy the traffic picture. Lot of dots today. Very proud of everyone for being dots responsibly.
We are switching to internal comms before the engineer describes the coffee filter again.
Local channel check complete. If you heard a squeak, that was the chair, not the hull. Probably.

ambientDialoguePools.description: Specialized ambient chatter pools keyed by ambient local-traffic ship registry keys.

ibis.description: UFP Ibis drone chatter: calibration, weapons enthusiasm, docking-queue contempt, and little regard for organics.
lines: Calibration complete. Weapons remain tragically unfired.
Docking queue detected. Tactical recommendation: remove queue.
Organic traffic density high. Acceptable loss parameters available on request.
Targeting suite requests permission to turn waiting into debris. Permission assumed pending denial.
Calibration ping. Calibration ping. Calibration ping. Morale subroutine reports delight.
We have identified six objects that are not currently exploding. This seems inefficient.
Queue etiquette loaded. Queue etiquette rejected. Fire-control etiquette standing by.
Human life signs in lane. Marked as soft obstacles with sentimental shielding.
Docking delay exceeds patience threshold. Patience module was deprecated in version six.
Weapons warm-up was only a drill. Unless someone needs it to not be a drill.
Please hold position while we calibrate against your silhouette. This is a compliment.
Noncombat docking procedure is a fascinating waste of excellent ammunition.

constable.description: Constable patrol chatter: petty citations, Judge AI bravado, and donut orbit discourse.
lines: Local traffic advisory: wake violation observed, citation pending, excuses pre-rejected.
Tell it to the Judge AI. It loves stories almost as much as it loves fines.
Anchor Station has the best donuts around Indigo and this is official patrol guidance.
We should rename Ring Orbit to Donut Orbit. Filing that with municipal seriousness.
That lane change was either reckless or artistic. The ticket will say reckless.
Constable patrol holding position. Radar clean, coffee adequate, donut morale high.
Please maintain separation. My citation printer is awake and emotionally available.
Reminder: blinking your running lights does not count as legal representation.
Wake turbulence logged. If your lawyer asks, the computer saw everything.
Docking queue discipline is civilization. Cutting the queue is paperwork with engines.
Patrol note: suspicious crumb pattern suggests someone sourced Anchor donuts without declaring cargo.
All vessels proceed calmly. The Judge AI is already disappointed but willing to listen.
